definitions.explanation: A man on his wedding day or who has recently married. Used in formal and ceremonial contexts, especially in wedding speeches and announcements.

examples.japanese: {新郎|しんろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦タキシード→タキシード：27070_takishiido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ていた→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The groom was wearing a tuxedo.

examples.japanese: {新郎|しんろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{新郎|しんろう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧{面持|おもも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新婦|しんぷ}→新婦：12981_shinpu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The groom waited for the bride's arrival with a nervous expression.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used at weddings and in ceremonial contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{花婿|はなむこ}→花婿：21346_hanamuko⟧ is more common. Almost always paired with ⟦{新婦|しんぷ}→新婦：12981_shinpu⟧ (bride) in the set phrase {新郎|しんろう}⟦{新婦|しんぷ}→新婦：12981_shinpu⟧ (bride and groom).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新郎|しんろう}⟦{新婦|しんぷ}→新婦：12981_shinpu⟧: the bride and groom
- {新郎|しんろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: the groom's greeting/speech
- {新郎|しんろう}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the groom's side (of the family/guests)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花婿|はなむこ}→花婿：21346_hanamuko⟧: groom (common, everyday term)
- ⟦{婿|むこ}→婿：10617_muko⟧: groom; son-in-law (informal)
